levels.label: Inspect-only opening
levels.allowed_claim: A supported receipt can be opened and modeled without executing its rerun contract.
levels.forbidden_inference: The reader has executed or reproduced the historical command.

levels.label: Freshness boundary
levels.allowed_claim: A revision mismatch classifies the receipt as stale and keeps the current outcome not-run.

levels.label: Explicit rerun preview
levels.allowed_claim: The preview names the command, mutation, interface, and human authorization boundary without running it.
levels.forbidden_inference: A rerun has been approved or executed.

levels.label: Current dev checkpoint
levels.status_display: Checks and stale reader flow reproduce on dev
levels.allowed_claim: The current dev head passes its local checks and reproduces stale classification with a blocked rerun preview.
levels.forbidden_inference: The current dev head has complete producer coverage or a hosted reader.

levels.label: Producer/state coverage
levels.allowed_claim: The local tests cover several fail-closed negative contracts.
levels.forbidden_inference: All producer, cancellation, mutation, and recovery states are covered.

levels.label: External release
levels.allowed_claim: Hosting and external publication remain unverified.
levels.forbidden_inference: The reader is live on GitHub, portfolio, or Handshake.
